```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm-wasm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  try {
    await client.listFiles(undefined);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(String(error));
  } finally {
    client.free();
  }
```
